entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Becoming the All Blacks' all-time leading try scorer is something Will Jordan will never forget | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?subscribe 

The 28-year-old wing scored a hattrick in New Zealand's 47-17 win over Italy in Wellington on Saturday night to take his tally to 50 test tries and break Doug Howlett's record of 49.

Jordan scored his second and third tries of the match in quick succession, and he said it was all a bit of a blur.

Read more: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/sport/702109/special-night-for-record-breaking-all-blacks-wing-will-jordan
